text: If your teen has a diagnosis of disruptive mood dysregulation disorder, gradually hand them the follow-up: their signs, their calming methods, their doctor's appointments. Tell them that looking after themselves is a sign of maturity, and that you are with them.

review_defects.reason: The English adds a transliteration '(nudhūj)' that is not present in the Arabic source.

translation.manual_fix_note: Rewritten 2026-10-04 with the Arabic: re-addressed to the parent (the tip spoke to the teen); Arabic no longer carries the Latin abbreviation DMDD.
